title: Concept: SQL Server connection string in a response
description: A sqlserver URI naming the server and the database in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The string tells an attacker the engine, the host and the catalogue, which shortens the path from an injection finding to data access.
applicability: Deployments that render a sqlserver URI naming the server and the database into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The string tells an attacker the engine, the host and the catalogue, which shortens the path from an injection finding to data access.
